additional_info.subject: RE: A new case manager was assigned to 0483249 CRM:00225351519
additional_info.body:
Hi Joao,
The same issue has occurred again on this charger — Outlet-4 has gone into fault.
As you know from the history of this device, we have performed 3–4 on-site interventions and replaced multiple components. The issue was eventually resolved after we reset and reconfigured the charger, but it appears to be recurring.
Approximately 1.5 months ago, Outlet-4 showed the same fault but recovered on its own. Today, the fault has occurred again, which is why we have not been able to close the ticket.
Could you please advise on how we should proceed?
Do you have any recommendations or further actions we should take to identify the root cause?
With best regards,
Yunus Emre Temel
